The decisive mistake was Movie_Expert's step 2 list of Daniel Craig films. It omitted the highest-rated candidates, including Casino Royale (144 min, IMDb about 8.0), Skyfall (143 min), and Knives Out (2019) and Glass Onion (2022, 139 min). It also wrongly described Spectre (148 min) as above 150 minutes. Every later check ran on this incomplete, partly wrong list, so the correct answer could never be found.
